title: Xun Er's Divine-Grade Bloodline
summary: Elder Tong Xuan ends the duel, and Dean Mang says the Gu Clan can no longer withhold the Xiao Clan's slot in the Heavenly Tomb. Xun Er's test passes ninth rank and reaches ten stars, a divine-grade bloodline the Gu Clan hasn't seen in a thousand years. Tong Xuan draws her the Rainbow Clan Mark with the Rainbow Divine Brush, and Hun Li of the Hun Clan decides she must be killed. That night Xun Er uses the Rainbow Clan Mark's authority to make the elders return the Xiao Clan's slot. Her father, Clan Leader Gu Yuan, asks Xiao Yan to give him the jade of Tuo She Gu Di, a key to a Dou Di ruin, but Xiao Yan refuses because it holds his father's soul signature. At the opening, Gu Qing Yang points out the other clans' heirs, including Hun Ya. The Heavenly Tomb gate appears, and each clan sends two people in for up to three years.
events: Tong Xuan stops the fight; Dean Mang secures the Xiao Clan's slot.
Xun Er tests at ten stars, a divine-grade bloodline.
Tong Xuan draws Xun Er the Rainbow Clan Mark.
Hun Li plots to kill Xun Er.
Xun Er makes the elders return the Xiao Clan's quota.
Gu Yuan asks for the jade of Tuo She Gu Di; Xiao Yan refuses.
Gu Qing Yang introduces the Ancient Clans' heirs.
cultivation: Xun Er's bloodline is tenth rank (divine-grade). Ninth-rank bloodline gives a chance at Dou Sheng (EP219). Tong Xuan says even he wouldn't have a fifty percent chance against Xiao Xuan.
